Rouh is under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`).

| `onnxruntime-web.LICENSE`, `onnxruntime-web.ThirdPartyNotices.txt` | ONNX Runtime Web 1.29.0, `rouh/static/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.*` (MIT, and the notices of the projects it is built from) |
| `silero-vad.LICENSE` | The Silero voice activity model, `rouh/static/silero-vad.onnx` (MIT) |

The Python packages are not copied into this repository: they are installed from PyPI, each with its own licence.
